agent._perm_note: 'dontAsk' auto-denies any tool not in a group's allowedTools (and not in the CLI's read-only safe set), never hangs, enforced by Claude Code regardless of the backing model. TOOL PERMISSIONS ARE PER-PROJECT — set allowedTools/disallowedTools on each group below (not here). No global list; a group with none runs read-only (fail-closed).
agent._bin_note: On Windows with an npm-global Claude Code, 'claude' is a claude.cmd shim — sbot resolves and runs it automatically (see docs/install.md). To pin an exact binary, set an absolute path, e.g. "C:/Users/me/.local/bin/claude.exe".
agent._autocompact_note: 上下文超过该 token 数即让 CLI 原地压缩会话(两个后端都生效;控制台「设置→运行限制」可改)。范围 100000–1000000,0 = 关闭(CLI 只在模型窗口边缘才压);区间外的值运行时会收编回边界。

_timezone_note: Product-wide time convention (IANA name). Message timestamps in prompts, the agent's TZ env, and the console clock all follow it — NOT the host system timezone. Default Asia/Shanghai (Beijing time); invalid values fall back to the default.
_projectsRoots_note: 项目根目录围栏(字符串或数组,认 ~):控制台里选目录 / 保存群绑定 / 从本机目录提炼风格,只认这些目录之内的路径(判据走 realpath,符号链接绕不出去)。不写 = ~/Projects(Windows 为 D:\Projects,无 D 盘则 %USERPROFILE%\Projects)。填 /、家目录、/Users 这类等于没围的值会被忽略并由 doctor 报出;配置文件里手写的越界老绑定照常运行,只在 doctor 里提示。
_preview_note: Group preview service (`sbot preview`): the sanctioned way for a group's agent to put an interactive HTML prototype on the LAN. PER-GROUP OVERRIDE: `groups[<chatId>].preview` overrides any of these keys for that group — the console group card exposes the common case as a 「常驻(不自动停)」 checkbox (writes idleMin:0 + maxHours:0). Only the operator sets policy: `--config` is refused inside a group so the agent cannot swap it (otherwise an agent asked to keep a link open forever could write its own config file and turn every reclaim off). Runs as a detached worker (survives the turn — so the agent never has to stall a turn to keep a link alive) and is reaped by the daemon when idle. idleMin/maxHours: 0 disables that limit. Ports are assigned deterministically per group inside portFrom..portTo — open that range on the firewall once. host 0.0.0.0 is what makes it reachable for group members; set 127.0.0.1 to keep previews local-only (the agent is then told the link is NOT reachable from the LAN). HTTP is plaintext — trusted networks only. Serving the project root is refused unless explicitly requested (and announced in the group).
_providers_note: Model brains. Swap = ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_MODEL per spawn. Per-provider tuning (fast/slow split, 1M compaction, timeouts, provider quirks) goes in `env`, applied on top of the process env. Endpoints/model-ids for glm/deepseek/minimax/volcano are a verified set; gpt (needs a local translation router — see docs/GPT-ROUTER.md) and kimi (hidden, borrowed preset) are NOT yet verified end to end — confirm at setup. toolQuality is a hint shown in the console — verify a model on your own tasks before routing complex code work off Claude.
_vision_note: Set "vision": false on any provider whose model is TEXT-ONLY (no image input). sbot then routes that provider's `claude` through a local strip-proxy that downgrades every image content block (screenshots, Read of a .png, MCP image returns) to a text placeholder — so image inputs no longer 400 the whole turn ('Model only support text input'). Omit or set true for vision-capable models (default = passthrough, unchanged). Auth/streaming are untouched; the proxy holds no secrets and listens on localhost only. Don't guess a model's capability — set false only when you've confirmed it rejects images.

claude._note: No baseUrl/apiKey -> uses your logged-in Claude Code auth (claude auth login). No "model" -> follows the CLI default model; set one in the console to pin a specific model. fallback: provider to switch to automatically when this one's subscription quota is used up (95% of a window, or a turn fails with a limit / account error); switches back when the window resets. Omit to disable.

glm._note: Zhipu GLM Anthropic-compatible endpoint. [1m] + AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW enable 1M context; fast/slow split routes sub-agents to glm-4.5-air. GLM-5.2 is TEXT-ONLY -> vision:false engages the strip-proxy (without it, a browser screenshot fails the whole turn with a 400). Docs: docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/coding-plan/tool/claude

deepseek._note: DeepSeek Anthropic-compatible endpoint. ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0 keeps the DeepSeek prefix cache from busting each turn (claude-code issue #40652); sub-agents run on the cheaper v4-flash. Docs: api-docs.deepseek.com/.../claude_code

minimax._note: MiniMax M3 Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Single model across all tiers (no fast/slow split). Strong at web-browsing/search agents. Docs: platform.minimaxi.com/docs/token-plan/claude-code

volcano._note: Volcano Ark Coding Plan — one endpoint packages GLM-5.2 / DeepSeek / etc.; switch by changing `model`. Console shows a percent bar only (no token API). vision:false matches the GLM-5.2 model above — if you switch `model` to a multimodal one, drop it. Docs: volcengine.com/docs/82379/1928262

gpt._note: [OPTIONAL — platform-API-key path. The default GPT route is the `codex` provider below (Codex CLI: spawns `codex exec`, auth via `codex login`; docs/CODEX-RUNNER.md). Kept hidden as a template for users who DO have an OpenAI platform key (subscription-driven Codex is rate-limited and multi-user use raises subscription-terms questions, so a platform key is the more reliable path).] GPT/OpenAI via a LOCAL translation router (claude-code-router / LiteLLM). OpenAI has NO Anthropic endpoint, so `claude` can't hit it directly like the /anthropic providers above — baseUrl points at YOUR running router (CCR default port shown; confirm yours), which translates Anthropic Messages <-> OpenAI Responses. KEYS: the ONLY real credential is your OpenAI key, and it lives in the ROUTER's config, never here. apiKey above is a DUMMY — without a token `claude` falls back to your logged-in OAuth credential, which a custom endpoint rejects, so the dummy just overrides that; any non-empty string works because a loopback router isn't auth-protected by default. ONLY if you deliberately set the router's own APIKEY must apiKey equal it (then use "env:CCR_API_KEY"). `sbot doctor` probes this loopback address and reports the `router:gpt` row as unreachable if the router isn't up, so the provider fails fast, never hangs. Prefer a Responses-API route (keeps cross-tool reasoning continuity). toolQuality:medium so hard code tasks still route to Claude. If `claude` rejects a non-Claude model id, set a Claude-safe alias here and map it router-side. If the router mishandles images, add "vision": false. Route decision: DESIGN section 6.1.

kimi._note: Kimi / Moonshot Anthropic-compatible endpoint (native — no router needed, works like glm/deepseek above). Borrowed from a maintained provider-preset table; VERIFY base_url + model id at setup (third-party model ids churn). hidden:true keeps it inert until you confirm and enable. Docs: platform.moonshot.cn

codex._note: GPT via Codex CLI — this project's default GPT path. NO baseUrl/apiKey: sbot spawns `codex exec` and auth is the machine's own `codex login` (ChatGPT coding-plan SUBSCRIPTION), never a key in config. Set a group's provider to `codex` to run GPT there. Sandbox comes from the group's permissionMode: bypassPermissions -> danger-full-access (lets GPT write files; Windows has no workspace-write sandbox) — set it only for trusted private groups; default dontAsk -> read-only (fail-closed). GPT shares your interactive Codex subscription quota (5h/weekly) — use sparingly. runner:'codex' selects this backend; Claude's allow/deny + MCP gating do NOT apply. reasoningEffort (minimal/low/medium/high) → `-c model_reasoning_effort`; omit for the model default (minimal/low is faster + saves quota, high is stronger/slower). No `model` on purpose: codex then uses its own default (the `model` in ~/.codex/config.toml, else the official default). A pinned id goes stale as new models ship, and some ids are rejected for ChatGPT-account logins ("model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account") — check `codex debug models` before pinning one. Details: docs/CODEX-RUNNER.md.

_alerts_note: 可选顶层 alerts 段,形如 {"chatId": "oc_xxx"}:运维告警群。模型账号异常(被停 / 登录态刷新失败)、订阅额度用完、群自动切换备用模型 / 切回,都会发一条到这个群 —— 不配的话,这些只在出事的那个群里说一句,你不在那个群就不知道。告警群要**保持未绑定项目**(绑了助手就会在里面干活,doctor 会 warn);去重:同一模型同类故障每小时最多一条,「已恢复」只在报过故障之后才报。不配 = 不发(doctor 只提示一句)。
_browser_note: 可选顶层 browser 段(docs/BROWSER.md),形如 {"cdpUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:9222", "takeoverMinutes": 10}:cdpUrl = 常驻 Chrome 的远程调试地址(默认本机 9222);takeoverMinutes = 群里发的「接管浏览器」一次性链接有效期(分钟,默认 10,范围 1~60)。这里故意不写 browser 键:不配 = 用默认值,而且 doctor 探不到浏览器也不告警(没有常驻 Chrome 的机器照抄示例不会平白多一条警告);配了才把探不到当 warn。
_proxy_note: 可选代理分流:官方 claude 走代理、国内端点直连。填了 proxy.http 才生效;sbot 会注入子进程 env(不覆盖 shell 已有值),daemon 自己出网的部分(Slack 的 REST 与 WebSocket)也走同一份配置与 noProxy(飞书 SDK 自带网络栈,不经此处)。`sbot setup` 能按你启用的 provider 自动生成 noProxy。留空/删除本块=不用代理。
_platform_note: 聊天平台可以同时接:配了 feishu 块(appId/appSecret)就接飞书,配了 slack 块(botToken/appToken)就接 Slack,配了 wecom 块(botId/secret)就接企业微信;每个群用 groups.<id>.platform("feishu" | "slack" | "wecom")说明属于哪边,没写的按群 id 形态推断(oc_ 飞书 / C·G·D 开头的大写 id 归 Slack / wr 企微;企微单聊 id 没形态,只配了一个平台时归它)。各平台开通见 docs/platforms/。
_slack_note: Slack:Socket Mode 长连接,免公网。用 docs/slack-app-manifest.yaml 建 App,取 Bot Token(xoxb-)与 App-Level Token(xapp-,connections:write);onlyWhenMentioned:true = 频道里只回 @ 机器人的消息;群内命令用 ! 前缀(Slack 会吃掉 / 开头的输入)。要启用就把 _slack_example 改名为 slack(docs/platforms/slack.md)
_wecom_note: 企业微信:后台「智能机器人 → 新建 → API 模式 → 使用长连接」拿 Bot ID + Secret;botName 用来剥正文里的 @;names 手工映射 userid→显示名(没装官方命令行工具时群里只显示 userid);welcome 首次单聊的欢迎语(可省);pollSec / followSec / keywords = 「不 @ 也回复」(轮询群历史的平时间隔〔刚聊过 8 秒一看、久没人说话 2 分钟一看,@ 的消息不走轮询随时即答〕/ 跟进窗口 / 点名词);gatekeeper = 它的第二道门,规则不放行的消息先问这个便宜模型要不要答(只能指有 baseUrl+apiKey 的模型;可省 = 没有这道门);要启用就把 _wecom_example 改名为 wecom(docs/WECOM.md)

ws._note: WS 活性看门狗调优(全可选,不写=用这些默认)。pingTimeoutSec 最关键:ping 无应答这么久就判死→重连(治『机器人变聋』);其余为强制重建的兜底节奏。按实际网络情况再调。

card._note: 流式打字机卡片的推送节流窗(ms)。模型每说一段就刷一次卡片=一次计入飞书月调用量的 API 调用;累积文本丢中间帧无损,故窗内只保留最后一帧(窗到补发)。调大=更省额度、打字机更粗(一行一行地出);0=逐帧推(最顺滑最费)。首帧不等待。

board._note: 设计画布自动感知(docs/BOARD.md),默认关:pollSec=0 时画布标注不自动播报,群成员回群里说一声 agent 就现拉。要开把 pollSec 设成 120(最小 30)= 对建过画布的群每隔这么多秒拉一次画板节点+评论,每群每轮约 2 次飞书 API 调用,120 秒一轮约每群每月 4 万次,计入飞书月调用量。holdRounds=用户还在画时最多押后几轮再播。改了要重启 daemon。

feishu._note: For `sbot start`. Default handles all group messages EXCEPT those @mentioning others-but-not-the-bot (needs botOpenId to tell them apart). Set onlyWhenMentioned:true to respond only when the bot is @'d. appId/appSecret support 'env:VAR'.

oc_example_chat_id._note: one project per group: chatId -> { workdir, provider?, model?, allowedTools?, disallowedTools? }. Omit provider to use defaultProvider. Permissions are PER-PROJECT and scoped to this workdir (cwd=workdir, no external --add-dir); tune allow/deny per project. Omit both ⇒ read-only (fail-closed). The lists above = the console's 开发 preset (只读=omit both, 全信任=Bash(*) etc with a strong warning). On Windows use a real path, e.g. "C:/Users/me/project-a".

_secrets: apiKey/appId/appSecret/botOpenId/botToken/appToken/secret support 'env:VAR_NAME' to read from the environment instead of hardcoding. `sbot setup` seeds ~/.sbot/config.json from this file; or copy it yourself and fill in. Field reference: docs/config.md.
